newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens firmer on Dow-inspired mark up.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens firmer on Dow-inspired mark up.

text.p: The FTSE 100 of leading UK shares started firmer on Wednesday with the effect of massive closing gains for the Dow dampened by rate concerns, dealers and strategists said.
The FTSE 100 was 7.7 points up 4,766.2 by 0737 GMT.
Today sees the start of a two-day Bank of England monetary meeting, with the market expecting a rate decision tomorrow.

"The arguments over whether it is going to be 25 or 50 basis points are really semantics. Twenty-five is adequate for now and everyone knows there is going to be more. Fifty looks like an indictment of the (new Labour government's first) budget," said Dresdner Kleinwort Benson strategist, Philip Isherwood.
